## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān's compact catechetical treatment of the *[Rù fǎjiè pǐn 入法界品](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0010)* — the closing chapter of the 80-fascicle *Avataṃsaka* containing the Sudhana pilgrimage — in 18 question-and-answer pairs. The format addresses 18 doctrinal cruxes raised by the chapter, with each question framed as a doctrinal inquiry and the answer providing Chéngguān's mature reading.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān's mature period, c. 787 – 838 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The work is part of Chéngguān's broader pedagogical-commentarial corpus on the *Avataṃsaka*, paralleling his *[Lüè cè](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0015)* (T1737, 42 questions) and *[Qī chù jiǔ huì sòng shì zhāng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0016)* (T1738) — multiple compact pedagogical works produced alongside the great commentaries.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X218) collection.
